rationale: Not ready. The build passes and a few requirements are evidenced (Godot 4 project layout except demo_outputs, clean headless launch, title first screen, four chapters of six level buttons, scenario skip-to-level and seeded entry, timer visible at 30.00, flash/rewind/respawn observed, several trace-format rules), but the game is not a shippable micro-game: the player falls out of the world (QA-002), interact is inert (QA-003), level content is a degenerate template with no temporal puzzles (QA-001), completion and reset were never observed (QA-005, QA-006), ghost interactions are unexercised (QA-004), the title trace is non-deterministic (QA-008), zero delivery traces are packaged (QA-007), and all art is mock placeholder (QA-010). Open blocker/major issues remain, and the host gates packaged_traces_replayed and final_art are false. Host abstained on 18 criterion decisions and withheld 3 issue updates. Host gate failures: packaged_traces_replayed, final_art, all_requirements_verified, no_blocking_issues, no_open_design_or_evidence_gaps.
